{{Top|ga}} {{Otheruses}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Pyke-Harvest.png]] |name=Pyke |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[4 BBY]], [[Mina-Rau]]"[[One Year Later]]" dates the first three episodes of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' [[Andor Season 2|Season 2]], including the [[death]] of Pyke on [[Mina-Rau]] in the episode "[[Harvest]]," to [[4 BBY]]. |species=[[Human]]{{Andor|Harvest}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him{{Andor|Harvest}} {{AD|Disney+}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Dark |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Krole's contingent]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|You've got five seconds to show your face before I turn the cannon on that shack.|Pyke, to Bix Caleen|}} '''Pyke''' was a [[corporal]] [[Imperial Army trooper]] that served the [[Galactic Empire]] in their [[Imperial Supply Census]] on the [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]] in [[4 BBY]]. Part of [[Lieutenant]] [[Krole]]'s [[Krole's contingent|contingent]], he drove a [[Unit One (Galactic Empire)|transport]] for them and chauffeured Krole to a [[mobil-haus]], where the lieutenant tried to force himself on the undocumented [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Bix Caleen]]. When Krole's advances ended [[Death|fatally]] for him, Pyke called for help and tried to confront Caleen. Another undocumented mechanic, [[Wilmon Paak]], fired on Pyke, leading to a short [[Skirmish on Mina-Rau|firefight]] in which the corporal was gunned down by Caleen. ==Biography== ===Imperial inspection=== {{Quote|Where you coming from?''"
"''We just finished Five Hundred.''"
"''You boys are working fast.|Kellen and one of Pyke's comrades|}} During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Pyke served as an [[Imperial Army trooper]], eventually reaching the [[military rank]] of [[corporal]]. In [[4 BBY]], he was with [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] deployed to the [[Agriworld|agricultural]] [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]] for an [[Imperial Supply Census]],{{Andor|One Year Later}} the first audit on that world in ten [[Standard year|years]]. As the Imperials surveyed [[Council Five Hundred]], an undocumented individual was caught running during their checks.{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} [[File:ShoppingSoldiers-Andor202.png|thumb|right|300px|Pyke (centre) and other soldiers at the general store]] After finishing at Five Hundred, Pyke went with a [[Krole's contingent|contingent]] of [[Soldier|army troopers]] and [[stormtrooper]]s led by [[Lieutenant]] [[Krole]] to a [[Mina-Rau General Store|general store]]. The contingent traveled in the [[transport]]s [[Unit One (Galactic Empire)|Unit One]] and [[Unit Two (Galactic Empire)|Unit Two]], Pyke being the driver of Unit One. After arriving at the store, Pyke joined some of his comrades in checking out the door, looking around at the produce while some of the other soldiers spoke with the store owner [[Kellen]]. Imperial forces continued with a survey of [[Council Six Hundred]], finding another group of undocumented individuals trying to hide. ===Fatal accomplice=== {{Quote|Unit Two. Unit Two. We have a problem out here. Trouble on site.''"
"''All right, stand by.|Pyke and another soldier|}} The next [[Standard day|day]], Krole's contingent [[Skirmish on Mina-Rau|returned]] to the general store, as their inspection was going to cover the local council next. Krole ordered for meals to be made for his troops, with two being saved for him and Pyke, who was driving Unit One again. The lieutenant then left [[Sergeant]] [[Stang (individual)|Stang]] in charge while he had Pyke drive him to a [[mobil-haus]] in [[Council 207]]. While Pyke rested in Unit One, Krole went to the mobil-haus and tried to blackmail the undocumented [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Bix Caleen]] into sexual favors. After the lieutenant's advances turned into assault, Caleen dealt two blows to him with a tool. Krole's subsequent screams caught the attention of Pyke, who contacted Unit Two for help before approaching the mobil-haus with a [[blaster pistol]] drawn. The corporal ignored Stang's attempts to contact him back, and a fatally injured Krole exited the building, falling onto a box and [[Death|dying]]. [[File:Pyke-Caleen-Andor203.png|thumb|left|300px|Pyke tries to confront Bix Caleen after Krole's death.]] In response to Pyke's sudden call, Stang put together reinforcements aboard Unit Two to help their comrades. Quickly scanning his surroundings, Pyke demanded Caleen show herself or he would fire Unit One's [[cannon]] on the mobil-haus. Caleen replied that Krole had tried to rape her, but the corporal cited his death and asked for her to step out. That was when another undocumented mechanic, [[Wilmon Paak]], fired on Pyke from the latter's flank. The two exchanged until Caleen caught the corporal off-guard and shot him dead. Meanwhile, Pyke's reinforcements were destroyed by the [[Axis network|rebel spy]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] in a stolen [[TIE Avenger prototype]], who helped Caleen and Paak escape. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|He tried to rape me.''"
"''He's dead. Step out slowly.|Caleen and Pyke, on Krole's demise|}} [[File:Pyke-aims-Andor203.png|thumb|right|300px|Pyke takes aim toward Caleen's position.]] Pyke was a [[human]] with [[Color|dark]] skin, black [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. He stood complicit with Krole's assault of Bix Caleen, only taking notice of the scuffle when the lieutenant screamed out. The corporal furthermore ignored the mechanic's statement on Krole's rape attempts, being set on bringing justice to her for his superior's death. ==Equipment== An Imperial Army trooper, Pyke donned a gray [[Clothing|uniform]] with pockets on his chest and [[Limb|arms]] and a black stripe below on his left upper arm. He also wore a black [[belt]] with a [[holster]]ed [[blaster]] [[pistol]], as well as black [[boot]]s, and a gray [[Imperial kepi]] with black goggles on. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|''Catch me as Corporal Pyke! The fall was as hard as it looks'' [''…'']|italics=0|David Omordia|{{Instagram|username=david.omordia|url=p/DIydH9_MAmK/|name=[[David Omordia]]|date=2025-04-23|archiveurl=https://archive.is/77i15}}}} Pyke was portrayed by [[David Omordia]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in "[[Sagrona Teema]]" and "[[Harvest]]," the second and third episodes of the show's [[Andor Season 2|second season]], which were released together on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} The outside scenes for Mina-Rau for ''Andor'' were filmed on [[Pinewood Studios]]' 007 stage.{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-1|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 1 Trivia}} During production, Omordia practiced Pyke's death with the assistance of a cable pulling him. He later stated when posting a video of the practicing that the fall was harder than it looked. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Harvest}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=パイク（人物） |ka=პაიკი (პერსონაჟი) }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Army troopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
